address: Nanjichang Night Market, 29, Lane 313, Section 2, Zhonghua Road, Zhongzheng District, Taipei, 100, Taiwan
bio: This shop has been selling the same tasty popiah rolls for over 30 years, though it was renamed and changed location. The fillings, including braised pork belly, tofu skin, ground peanuts and pork floss, impart rich texture. Vegetarian version available.
